questions.query: Compare the datasets used across these papers.
questions.notes: Cross-paper retrieval should pull methods or results evidence from multiple papers.
The planner should infer a year floor and methods-oriented evidence.

questions.query: What limitations or failure cases do these papers mention?
questions.notes: This is a harder retrieval question because the answer may come from discussion or conclusion sections.

questions.query: Explain the main idea of this paper and how its method works.
questions.notes: Single-paper explanation should stay anchored to one paper and retrieve multiple within-paper evidence chunks.
